notes.title: Conquest! is live!
notes.content:
Now available on Steam!

Join the 100% free (no ads, no P2W!) cross-platform multi-player RTS fantasy war game today!

Also available on these stores:

 Apple App Store
 Google Play
 Galaxy Store
 Microsoft Store
 Amazon App Store


Conquest! began in 1993 as a text based game on IRC (Conquest on #efnet). Visit conquestgamesite.com/history to read about the history of the game.
